## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
#  PLOT GROWTH CURVES — Individual + Combined
#  --------------------------------------------
#  Reads Trial_AK_G1_EXP.xlsx, does blank subtraction,
#  then produces:
#    1. One plot per group, saved as individual .jpg files
#    2. One combined plot with all groups overlaid
#    3. A faceted plot (all groups side by side)
```

You can add options to executable code like this 

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
library(paletteer)
```

```{r}
#CONFIGURATION

INPUT_FILE <- "/Users/tranthihongnhung/Desktop/MasterThesis/PlateReader/Draft_Analysis_AK/Trial_AK_G1_EXP.xlsx"

GROUP_NAMES <- c(
  "A" = "YCFAG",
  "B" = "WC",
  "C" = "-YE",
  "D" = "CH",
  "E" = "-YE_CH"
)

# Plot settings
LOESS_SPAN       <- 0.25       # Smoothing amount (smaller = more wiggly)
ERRORBAR_SD_MULT <- 0.75       # Error bar length as fraction of SD
X_BREAKS_BY      <- 6          # X-axis tick interval (hours)
X_LIMITS         <- c(0, 48)   # X-axis range
Y_LIMITS         <- NULL       # Y-axis range (NULL = auto-fit)
PALETTE          <- "ggthemes::Superfishel_Stone"
DPI              <- 450
OUTPUT_DIR       <- "/Users/tranthihongnhung/Desktop/MasterThesis/PlateReader/Draft_Analysis_AK_New"
```


```{r}
#READ AND PROCESS DATA
parse_time <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x)
  m <- regmatches(x, regexec("(\\d+)\\s*h\\s*(?:(\\d+)\\s*min)?", x))
  sapply(m, function(match) {
    if (length(match) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    h <- as.numeric(match[2])
    mins <- ifelse(match[3] == "" | is.na(match[3]), 0, as.numeric(match[3]))
    h + mins / 60
  })
}

raw <- read_excel(INPUT_FILE, sheet = "Sheet1", col_names = FALSE)

# Extract header info
well_names <- as.character(raw[1, 3:ncol(raw)])
content    <- as.character(raw[2, 3:ncol(raw)])
groups     <- as.character(raw[3, 3:ncol(raw)])

# Time labels
time_labels <- as.character(raw[[2]][4:nrow(raw)])
times_h     <- parse_time(time_labels)
n_tp        <- sum(!is.na(times_h))

# Build tidy data
od_long <- map_dfr(seq_along(well_names), function(j) {
  od_values <- as.numeric(raw[[j + 2]][4:nrow(raw)])
  tibble(
    well    = well_names[j],
    content = ifelse(grepl("Sample", content[j]), "sample", "blank"),
    group   = groups[j],
    time_h  = times_h[1:n_tp],
    od600   = od_values[1:n_tp]
  )
})

# Blank subtraction: per-group mean blank at each time point
blank_means <- od_long %>%
  filter(content == "blank") %>%
  group_by(group, time_h) %>%
  summarise(blank_od = mean(od600, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

od_corrected <- od_long %>%
  filter(content == "sample") %>%
  left_join(blank_means, by = c("group", "time_h")) %>%
  mutate(od_corrected = od600 - blank_od)

# Add readable group names
od_corrected <- od_corrected %>%
  mutate(Medium_Conditions = GROUP_NAMES[group])

# Summary: mean +/- SD per group per time point
summary_data <- od_corrected %>%
  group_by(Medium_Conditions, group, time_h) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_OD600 = mean(od_corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_OD600   = sd(od_corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rep      = sum(!is.na(od_corrected)),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(group, time_h)

cat(sprintf("Data ready: %d groups, %d time points\n",
            n_distinct(summary_data$group), n_tp))
```

```{r}
od_corrected_data <- od_corrected %>%
  select(time_h, well, od_corrected) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = well,
  values_from = od_corrected) %>%
  
  rename(Time = time_h)
  
write.csv(od_corrected_data, file = "/Users/tranthihongnhung/Desktop/MasterThesis/PlateReader/Draft_Analysis_AK_New/od_corrected_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

metadata_samples <- od_corrected %>%
  select(well, group, Medium_Conditions) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(curve_id = well,.before = well)
  
write.csv(metadata_samples, file = "/Users/tranthihongnhung/Desktop/MasterThesis/PlateReader/Draft_Analysis_AK_New/metadata_samples.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#PLOTTING

plot_growth <- function(
    data,
    selected_groups,
    title_text     = " Am growth curves",
    output_file    = NULL,
    show_legend    = TRUE,
    x_breaks_by    = X_BREAKS_BY,
    x_limits       = X_LIMITS,
    y_limits       = Y_LIMITS,
    loess_span     = LOESS_SPAN,
    errorbar_sd    = ERRORBAR_SD_MULT,
    palette_name   = PALETTE,
    width          = 8,
    height         = 6
) {

  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(Medium_Conditions %in% selected_groups) %>%
    mutate(Medium_Conditions = factor(Medium_Conditions, levels = selected_groups))

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x     = time_h,
      y     = Mean_OD600,
      color = Medium_Conditions,
      group = Medium_Conditions
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = Mean_OD600 - errorbar_sd * SD_OD600,
        ymax = Mean_OD600 + errorbar_sd * SD_OD600
      ),
      width = 0.3, alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method   = "loess",
      span     = loess_span,
      se       = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(x_limits[1], x_limits[2], by = x_breaks_by),
      labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:00", as.integer(x)),
      limits = x_limits
    ) +
    scale_color_paletteer_d(palette_name) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x     = "Time (h)",
      y     = expression(OD[600]~"(blank-corrected)"),
      color = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_markdown(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position  = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits)
  }

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    filepath <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, output_file)
    ggsave(filepath, plot = p, dpi = DPI, width = width, height = height)
    cat(sprintf("  Saved: %s\n", filepath))
  }

  invisible(p)
}
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
```{r}
#PLOT EACH CONDITION

all_groups <- unique(summary_data$Medium_Conditions)

for (grp in all_groups) {
  safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", grp)

  plot_growth(
    data            = summary_data,
    selected_groups = grp,
    title_text      = grp,
    output_file     = paste0("growth_curve_", safe_name, ".jpg"),
    show_legend     = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
#COMBINE PLOTS
plot_growth(
  data            = summary_data,
  selected_groups = all_groups,
  title_text      = "Am growth curves",
  output_file     = "growth_curve_ALL_combined.jpg"
)
```

```{r}
#FACETED PLOT

p_facet <- ggplot(
  summary_data %>% mutate(Medium_Conditions = factor(Medium_Conditions, levels = all_groups)),
  aes(x = time_h, y = Mean_OD600, color = Medium_Conditions)
) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = Mean_OD600 - ERRORBAR_SD_MULT * SD_OD600,
      ymax = Mean_OD600 + ERRORBAR_SD_MULT * SD_OD600
    ),
    width = 0.3, alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = LOESS_SPAN, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~Medium_Conditions, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(X_LIMITS[1], X_LIMITS[2], by = X_BREAKS_BY),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:00", as.integer(x)),
    limits = X_LIMITS
  ) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d(PALETTE) +
  labs(
    title = "Growth curves — individual panels",
    x     = "Time (h)",
    y     = expression(OD[600]~"(blank-corrected)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_markdown(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position  = "none",
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_facet)
ggsave(
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "growth_curve_FACETED.jpg"),
  plot = p_facet, dpi = DPI, width = 12, height = 8
)
```
